Current simulation methods · reviewed 18 October 2026

Current method · Historical scalar reference

Start with the selected method and active controls in the workspace. Fresh configurations use annual paths. Saved configurations without a method retain legacy scalar sampling; saved growth-only annual configurations retain that scope until annual operating inputs are enabled. The dated scalar explanation below is retained for reference, not a description of every current run.

What annual paths sample

Each active primitive follows Gaussian AR(1) deviations around its edited annual baseline: growth, operating margin, operating tax rate, WACC and capital. Guided uses incremental sales/capital; the Annual model uses a net-investment response factor. Revenue, EBIT, cash tax, NOPAT, FCFF, discount factors and implied capital returns are then calculated once from those inputs. They do not receive duplicate independent shocks.

Annual growth replaces the scalar growth distribution. With annual operating inputs enabled, annual capital replaces the scalar capital distribution or investment multiplier; scalar margin and WACC draws set terminal endpoints only. Optional terminal growth, tax and marginal ROIC are drawn once per scenario and start Fixed. Scalar controls offer Fixed, Triangular, Uniform and Bounded normal distributions; annual innovations remain Gaussian, regardless of that scalar family choice. Guided terminal sales/capital is derived from terminal growth, margin, tax and ROIC rather than drawn independently.

Annual innovations are independent across primitives. Persistence connects years within one primitive; it does not create demand–margin or other cross-input dependence. Guided’s optional operating-linked setting concerns remaining scalar draws only, never annual innovations. The Annual model supports independent scalar draws only. Relationships inherited through shared cash-flow calculations are different from modeled correlations between business shocks.

SD, persistence and exact anchors

Innovation SD describes new shocks before conditioning, not the resulting annual path SD or cumulative-revenue uncertainty. Growth, margin, tax and WACC SDs use percentage points; sales/capital uses ratio units and the investment factor uses multiples. Persistence and the distance to exact anchors affect the resulting uncertainty; conditioning narrows it near anchors.

Selected fixed forecast years keep that primitive’s edited baseline value exactly. They are modeling conditions, not a claim that future guidance is certain. A fixed growth rate does not fix revenue when earlier growth is uncertain. Historical opening facts, source-defined timing stubs, protected funding and the terminal continuation are separate constraints; clearing user-selected fixed years does not remove them.

Paths are conditioned on selected fixed years and terminal endpoints. Zero SD removes residual innovation noise, but a changed terminal endpoint can still move the conditional mean between anchors. Zero SD with unchanged baseline endpoints reproduces the baseline path. Sampled terminal growth applies from the selected maturity year across its stable plateau; a conflicting user-fixed year requires removing that anchor or keeping terminal growth fixed at baseline. All explicitly fixed years retain their baseline values even when the terminal continuation changes.

Defaults are assumptions, including zero-width references

Fresh research configurations for the original 14 companies use a 3 percentage-point growth innovation SD, 0.6 persistence and exact forecast years 1–3. New operating-metric SDs are zero; company-specific scalar margin and WACC settings may still vary terminal endpoints. These are illustrative choices, not calibrated volatility or certainty estimates. Inactive scalar growth or investment settings do not drive annual-path results.

Fresh/reset references for KLAC, AMAT, LRCX, ASML, FN, CDNS and SNPS use zero annual SDs, no user-selected exact forecast years, fixed terminal distributions and fixed scalar stresses. Persistence is an inactive zero placeholder only while SDs and baseline endpoints remain unchanged. These runs repeat the selected conditional reference value; they do not estimate a confidence range. Saved configurations remain preserved and can differ.

Capital, discounting and claims follow the selected model

What joint annual paths sample

Each active primitive follows jointly Gaussian AR(1) deviations around an edited, terminal-scenario baseline: growth, operating margin, operating tax rate, WACC and capital. Tax and WACC residual uncertainty are optional; their innovation SDs can remain zero. Guided uses incremental sales/capital; the Annual model uses a net-investment response factor. Annual growth replaces the scalar growth distribution. With annual operating inputs enabled, annual capital replaces the scalar capital distribution or investment multiplier; scalar margin and WACC draws define terminal endpoints. Optional terminal growth, tax and marginal ROIC are drawn once per scenario and start Fixed. In joint mode, these prescribed terminal draws first select a deterministic scenario baseline using the existing unit-bridge mean response; joint residual paths are then conditioned within that scenario. Noisy yearly targets do not reweight this imposed terminal mixture. This is a scenario-baseline model, not a posterior distribution over terminal endpoints. Scalar controls offer Fixed, Triangular, Uniform and Bounded normal distributions; annual innovations remain Gaussian, regardless of that scalar family choice. Guided terminal sales/capital is derived from terminal growth, margin, tax and ROIC rather than drawn independently.

Joint innovations use one common factor plus independent residual factors. Each loading b lies between −1 and 1; the correlation of two standardized one-year innovations is b_i × b_j before conditioning. Loadings start at zero, and an input with zero innovation SD has no realized innovation correlation. Persistence links years within each primitive. Joint conditioning can transmit a target across linked inputs and years; the displayed innovation correlations are not conditioned path or accepted-value correlations. The older annual-path method keeps independent innovations across primitives. Guided’s optional operating-linked setting concerns remaining scalar draws only, never annual innovations. The Annual model retains independent scalar terminal draws. None of these relationships is a calibrated company correlation.

SD, persistence, exact anchors and noisy targets

Innovation SD describes new shocks before conditioning, not the resulting annual path SD or cumulative-revenue uncertainty. Growth, margin, tax and WACC SDs use percentage points; sales/capital uses ratio units and the investment factor uses multiples. Joint-mode year targets use a separate observation-error SD in the same input units: SD 0 is an exact target; SD > 0 is independent Gaussian observation error, not a hard interval or an imposed target distribution. Exact and noisy observations are conditioned jointly across metrics and years. Persistence and the constraints affect the resulting path SD. Exported conditional path SD excludes between-terminal-scenario variation and economic exclusion effects.

Selected fixed forecast years keep that primitive’s edited baseline value exactly. They are modeling conditions, not a claim that future guidance is certain. Zero SD with unchanged baseline endpoints and no conflicting exact targets reproduces the baseline path; a noisy target cannot move a deterministic input. Incompatible exact targets are rejected rather than relaxed. Sampled terminal growth applies from the selected maturity year across its stable plateau; a conflicting user-fixed year requires removing that anchor or keeping terminal growth fixed at baseline. All explicitly fixed years retain their baseline values even when the terminal continuation changes.

Defaults are assumptions, including zero-width references

Fresh research configurations for the original 14 companies retain a 3 percentage-point growth innovation SD, 0.6 persistence and exact forecast years 1–3, together with their existing terminal priors. New operating-metric SDs are zero and all common-factor loadings start at zero; company-specific scalar margin and WACC settings may still vary terminal endpoints. These are illustrative choices, not calibrated volatility, correlation or certainty estimates. No new operating volatility or correlation is inferred. Inactive scalar growth or investment settings do not drive annual-path results.

Persistence is an inactive zero placeholder only while SDs and baseline endpoints remain unchanged. Fixed investment does not automatically rebuild capacity when revenue changes. Revenue scaling is a proportional sensitivity, not a complete capacity, maintenance-capex or working-capital model. Annual WACC paths feed the existing discount-factor calculation; terminal cash flow retains reinvestment for sampled growth and ROIC. Source facts, horizon, timing and dated claims inputs remain fixed, while scenario-dependent claim allocations are recalculated where the selected model requires them.

Run explicitly and read accepted outcomes

Changing assumptions does not start a simulation. Choose Run simulation to calculate new results; edits make previous results stale. Chart replay uses already-computed outcomes and creates no new draws. Reproducibility requires the same source, edited baseline, active settings, seed and software version. Exports identify annual paths, terminal draws, input scopes and exclusions.

The requested trial count is an attempt count. Out-of-domain or numerically invalid paths are excluded without clipping or replacement. Frequencies and quantiles are conditional on accepted outcomes; review exclusion reasons and counts. Some bounds are application limits, not universal economic impossibilities. Excluded paths are not a default probability, and plausible business failure is not modeled by discarding invalid inputs.

Read the selected output basis and bridge coverage. The Annual model starts with signed operating enterprise value; equity and per-share results require an eligible source-dated allocation. Its general signed outputs differ from Guided’s zero per-share floor; source-specific allocation rules, including Fabrinet’s zero ordinary value for a nonpositive allocation pool, still apply. Annual research supplies no verified current-price comparison. Missing claims, shares or quotes are not filled with zero.

Quantiles describe these assumptions and constraints, not statistical confidence in true value, a stock-price forecast or a chance of profit. More trials improve numerical precision within the assumed model. They do not calibrate the business story, correct missing dependencies or create a financing, distress or recovery model.

Framework and implementation choices

Damodaran’s framework draws important uncertain inputs and revalues the business; it allows annual draws and dependence across inputs and time. The Gaussian AR(1) bridge, exact future anchors, independence assumptions and defaults here are this app’s choices. They are not parameters prescribed or endorsed by Damodaran. The dated historical reference below explains the original scalar implementation and bounded-normal mathematics.

Damodaran: Dealing with Distress in Valuation, Steps in Simulation · Damodaran: Probabilistic Approaches

  "text.578335999be711447a1e": "每个启用的基本输入，都以编辑后、由终值情景决定的基准为中心，加入联合高斯 AR(1) 偏差：增长率、营业利润率、经营税率、WACC 及资本投入。税率及 WACC 的残差不确定性为可选项，其新冲击 SD 可保持为零。引导估值采用增量销售额／资本比率；年度模型采用净投资响应因子。收入、EBIT、现金税、NOPAT、FCFF、折现因子及隐含资本回报率，均由这些输入计算一次，不另加重复的独立冲击。",

  "text.e74903194ca863d42138": "以下原始说明作为有日期的历史实作纪录保留。其中的单一向量路径、固定 WACC 说法、公司限制、四输入预设值及来源特定索偿权描述，不应视为目前年度方法，也不保证今日旧版模式的行为。请以以上目前方法说明及工作区所选控制项为准。",
  "text.8a7a0ccfb413b614f10c": "路径遵守选定的固定年度及终值端点。零新冲击 SD 移除剩余的新冲击噪声，但改变终值端点仍可通过情景基准移动条件均值。零 SD 搭配不变的基准端点，且没有冲突的精确目标时，会重现基准路径；含噪声目标不能改变确定性输入。不兼容的精确目标会被拒绝，不会放宽。抽样的永续增长率自选定成熟年度起，适用于整段稳定期；若与用户固定年度冲突，须移除该锚点，或将永续增长率固定为基准值。即使终值延续条件改变，所有明确固定的年度仍保留基准值。",
  "text.53f4f021bdebbcefcd9b": "年度模型保留所选的固定排程、随营收缩放或承诺投入底线加成长资本反应。年度投资因子在该反应之后套用。固定排程下，因子为 1 会保留编辑后、准备金变动前的投资额；随营收反应的政策则可能改变该金额。受保护的固定资金安排不乘以因子，必要营运现金的变动另外推导。直接的带正负号投资金额路径，仅支援固定排程。 所选公司的资金投入底线可在投资反应之后增加补足额；请参阅该情境的资金安排说明。",
  "text.5d4b4996e087bc943e15": "年度增长路径取代标量增长率分布。启用年度经营输入时，年度资本路径取代标量资本分布或投资乘数；标量利润率及 WACC 抽样定义终值端点。可选的永续增长率、税率及边际 ROIC 每个情景抽样一次，初始为 Fixed。联合模式先以这些预设的终值抽样，通过现有单位桥接均值响应选定确定性的情景基准，再在该情景内对联合残差路径条件化。含噪声的年度目标不会重新加权这项外加的终值混合分布。这是情景基准模型，并非终值端点的后验分布。标量控制项提供 Fixed、Triangular、Uniform 及 Bounded normal 分布；无论选择哪种标量分布，年度新冲击仍为高斯分布。引导估值的终值销售额／资本比率由永续增长率、利润率、税率及 ROIC 推导，不另行独立抽样。",

"text.c98cd2866cbcee3e61a9": "目前方法",

  "text.07280f26449128666798": "請先查看工作區所選的方法及啟用的控制項。新設定採用年度路徑；沒有方法欄位的已存設定保留舊版純量抽樣。僅含年度成長率的已存設定，會維持原範圍，直到啟用年度營運輸入。下方保留有日期的純量方法說明供參考，並非所有目前模擬的描述。",
  "text.64a1e00bb63dca722c21": "年度路徑抽樣哪些輸入",
  "text.af945d1cb6622df7ae3a": "每個啟用的基本輸入都以編輯後的年度基準為中心，加入高斯 AR(1) 偏差：成長率、營業利潤率、營運稅率、WACC 及資本投入。引導估值採用增量銷售額／資本比率；年度模型採用淨投資反應因子。營收、EBIT、現金稅、NOPAT、FCFF、折現因子及隱含資本報酬率，均由這些輸入計算一次，不另加重複的獨立衝擊。",
  "text.120058d0109de7d4fc43": "年度成長路徑取代純量成長率分布。啟用年度營運輸入時，年度資本路徑取代純量資本分布或投資乘數；純量利潤率及 WACC 抽樣只設定終值端點。可選的永續成長率、稅率及邊際 ROIC 每個情境抽樣一次，初始為 Fixed。純量控制項提供 Fixed、Triangular、Uniform 及 Bounded normal 分布；無論選擇哪種純量分布，年度新衝擊仍為高斯分布。",
  "text.cd3f00a21acfa8caceb3": "各基本輸入的年度新衝擊彼此獨立。持續性連結同一輸入的不同年度，並不建立需求與利潤率等跨輸入依存關係。引導估值的可選 operating-linked 設定僅作用於仍啟用的純量抽樣，不作用於年度新衝擊。年度模型僅支援獨立純量抽樣。共用現金流計算所產生的關聯，與對企業衝擊相關性的建模不同。",
  "text.819b420fed980e065b32": "SD、持續性與精確錨點",
  "text.6ee5abdfa29565974f48": "新衝擊 SD 描述條件化前的新衝擊，不是最終年度路徑的 SD，也不是累積營收的不確定性。成長率、利潤率、稅率及 WACC 的 SD 使用百分點；銷售額／資本使用比率單位，投資因子使用倍數。持續性及與精確錨點的距離會影響最終不確定性；條件化使錨點附近的不確定性縮小。",
  "text.2c2d7cdb47dfb58d7766": "選定的固定預測年度，會精確保留該基本輸入編輯後的基準值。這是模型條件，並非聲稱未來指引確定。若較早的成長率仍不確定，固定某年的成長率並不會固定該年營收。歷史期初事實、來源定義的短期區段、受保護的資金安排及終值延續條件屬於不同限制；清除使用者選定的固定年度不會移除這些限制。",
  "text.4b189f403264739c2263": "路徑以選定的固定年度及終值端點為條件。零 SD 移除剩餘的新衝擊雜訊，但改變終值端點仍可移動錨點之間的條件平均值。零 SD 搭配不變的基準端點會重現基準路徑。抽樣的永續成長率自選定成熟年度起，適用於整段穩定期；若與使用者固定年度衝突，須移除該錨點，或將永續成長率固定為基準值。",
  "text.822584697d7cd936e9a6": "預設值也是假設，包括零寬度參考設定",
  "text.e73e6b6c0db423baf807": "原有 14 家公司的新研究設定，採用 3 個百分點的成長率新衝擊 SD、0.6 持續性，並精確固定預測第 1–3 年。新增營運指標的 SD 為零；各公司的純量利潤率及 WACC 設定仍可能改變終值端點。這些是示例選擇，並非經校準的波動率或確定性估計。停用的純量成長率或投資設定不會影響年度路徑結果。",
  "text.e6df3505685623db4264": "KLAC、AMAT、LRCX、ASML、FN、CDNS 及 SNPS 的新建／重設參考設定，採用零年度 SD、不預選精確固定預測年度、固定終值分布及固定純量壓力值。只有在 SD 及基準端點均不變時，零持續性才是不啟用的佔位值。這些模擬重複所選的條件參考估值，並不估計信賴區間。已存設定會保留，因此可能不同。",
